question: An aeroplane flies along the four sides of a square field at the speeds of 150 km/h, 300 km/h, 450 km/h and 600 km/h. Find the average speed of the plane around the field.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the side of the square field be the LCM of given speeds, i.e., LCM(150, 300, 450, 600) = 1800 km.

Total Distance = 4 × 1800 = 7200 km.

Total Time = (1800 ÷ 150) + (1800 ÷ 300) + (1800 ÷ 450) + (1800 ÷ 600) = 12 + 6 + 4 + 3 = 25 hours.

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time = 7200 ÷ 25 = 288 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 288 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 150 km/h
 300 km/h
 450 km/h
 600 km/h
 Square Field
 Side = d km

**Given:**

Speeds along the four sides of a square field are 150 km/h, 300 km/h, 450 km/h and 600 km/h.

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the distance of each side of the square be d km.

⇒ Total Distance around the field = d + d + d + d = 4d km.

⇒ Total Time taken = (d ÷ 150) + (d ÷ 300) + (d ÷ 450) + (d ÷ 600)

⇒ Taking LCM of 150, 300, 450 and 600, which is 1800.

⇒ Total Time = (12d + 6d + 4d + 3d) ÷ 1800

⇒ Total Time = 25d ÷ 1800 = d ÷ 72 hours.

⇒ Average Speed = 4d ÷ (d ÷ 72)

⇒ Average Speed = 4 × 72 = 288 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 288 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Two Equal Distances

When a person covers two equal distances at speeds x and y, the average speed is given by (2xy) ÷ (x + y).

Average Speed for Three Equal Distances

When a person covers three equal distances at speeds x, y and z, the average speed is given by (3xyz) ÷ (xy + yz + zx).

Average Speed for Unequal Distances

If distances d₁, d₂, d₃... are covered at speeds v₁, v₂, v₃... respectively, the average speed is (d₁ + d₂ + d₃...) ÷ (t₁ + t₂ + t₃...).
